paragraph.value: Maia Mitšulis · The first certified PCM trainer in Estonia

I deliver practical tools to understand personality,
reduce stress, communicate better
at work and beyond it.

Communication can become difficult long before
anyone calls it a communication problem.
You say the same thing to two people — and get completely different reactions.
You explain something clearly, but later realise it was understood differently.
A conversation that should be simple suddenly becomes tense, confusing or exhausting.
Under stress, someone familiar starts communicating in a way that feels completely unlike them.
There is a pattern behind all of this. Once you can see it, these moments stop feeling random and become easier to navigate.
Find the starting point that works for you below.
How we can work together

title.value: Find the right starting point for you:

paragraph.value: You don’t need to know which training or consultation format you need. Start with context that feels close to yours.
Build a shared language for communication, strengthen collaboration and give people practical tools for working with differences.
Workshops · Team training · PCM training
Understand what different employees need from you, adapt your communication more precisely and recognise stress patterns earlier.
Leadership training · Team development
Work through a specific communication challenge or go deeper into your own personality structure, needs and stress patterns.
Individual consultation · PCM Profile & debrief
Why PCM

title.value:
A practical way
to understand
what sits behind
communication

paragraph.value: PCM stands for Process Communication Model®. It is a research-based communication model rooted in psychological principles, with a methodology refined and validated through decades of research.
Some people naturally focus on facts and structure, others on people and feelings, values, reactions, action or imagination. The same message can therefore land very differently.
Different people draw energy from different psychological needs. What helps one person feel motivated and involved may do very little for someone else — or even create friction.

Under stress, communication patterns shift. People may become more controlling, critical, withdrawn, reactive or impulsive. PCM helps you recognise these changes earlier and respond more deliberately.
The goal is to have more than one way to reach them.
About the trainer
I’m Maia Mitšulis, Estonia’s first PCM trainer, certified in January 2025.

Harmony has always mattered to me. I started my professional life in design, first graphic and later interior design. Back then, I looked for harmony in images, objects and spaces. I wanted them to be beautiful, functional and supportive to the people living with them.
Over time, my attention shifted from the space around people to the space between people.
That shift eventually led me to PCM. I first explored it for myself, and the more I learned, the more it felt like the direction I wanted to follow.

Today, as a PCM communication trainer, I help leaders, teams and individuals understand communication, motivation and stress more clearly. I love creating a welcoming and light atmosphere where people feel seen and appreciated, and leave with practical insights they can actually use.
Thanks to PCM, I can understand my conversation partner and the situation more quickly. This means that less energy is expended and decisions are made more quickly.

title.value: Do I need to know anything about PCM before we start?

paragraph.value: No. You do not need any previous knowledge of PCM. We can start with a situation you are facing, with understanding your team better, or with a communication challenge you would like to solve.

PCM uses a professional personality profile, but the value is not in assigning a label. The profile helps you understand how you perceive the world, what motivates you, how you communicate and what tends to happen under stress.

title.value: Is PCM only for workplace communication?

paragraph.value: No. The same patterns appear at work, in families, relationships and everyday communication. The context may change, but the way people perceive, react and connect often follows the same underlying patterns.

title.value: Can I work with you individually?

paragraph.value: Yes. Most of my training work is with leaders and teams, but I also work individually with people who want to understand a specific communication situation, a recurring pattern or themselves more deeply. From time to time, I also run open trainings that individuals can join independently of a company.

title.value: Do I need to start with a full training or personality profile?

paragraph.value: No. We can start small. For a team, that may be a short practical workshop or introductory session. Individually, you can start with a consultation without profiling and go deeper if you find it useful.

title.value: What languages do you work in?

paragraph.value: I work in Estonian, English and Russian.
You do not need to choose a training format or understand PCM before getting in touch.
Tell me briefly what is happening — in your team, in your role as a leader or in a communication situation you would like to understand better.
We can then decide what kind of support would make sense.
